title: DREDge: robust motion correction for high-density extracellular recordings across species
goal: Reproduce the original Pt01–Pt03 human DREDge result: source-native LFP motion estimates and manual-trace agreement, with the source-linked before/after neural alignment and fidelity evidence. Assess improvement of manual-trace agreement on the same original complete patient panel only after its comparison and fidelity criteria are justified. Report the local held-channel consistency and alternate-settings panel separately as a prospective diagnostic extension.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.
Improvement: candidate outputs and a comparison on the same original task under improvement.v1.json.
Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
Author-baseline replay remains calibration. Historical reconstruction attempts retain their original scope and are not promoted to new qualified AI reproduction results.
Apply the reviewed same-primary scope correction. A partial component or a prospective extension cannot alone establish the complete primary result; unchanged improvement criteria still apply.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Dryad version224794 raw AP/LFP bins, channel maps, sampling metadata and motion outputs; source LFP/AP notebooks and dredge_lfp implementation are pinned. Previously aligned outputs are not raw inputs.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: DREDge human Neuropixels motion correction on the three released human AP/LFP recordings; fit displacement from real voltage and assess temporal registration consistency.
unresolved_coverage: No external ground-truth human displacement labels: agreement/consistency or stability gains do not establish absolute biological motion truth.
Matlab channel map/meta and sampling units must be validated with loader before running.
Covers released human data, not every species or all synthetic-ground-truth experiments.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

provenance.interpretation: Pins bind saved local evidence. Asset hashes are source-reported unless an explicit acquisition receipt says otherwise.

improvement.improvement_loop: Inactive until source endpoint recovery. Any later iteration must use separately declared development evidence while preserving the source human comparison and recording membership.
improvement.candidate_freeze: Before source final evaluation, freeze code, registration parameters, preprocessing, input-support policy, displacement outputs and the original alignment/metric evaluator.
improvement.final_evaluation: Replay both methods on every original Pt01-Pt03 source interval using the recovered manual reference; no new channel/time split can substitute. Operator-held reference traces remain unavailable to candidate fitting.
improvement.baseline_policy: Keep source per-patient correlations, a future native author rerun and any prospective consistency diagnostics distinct. No native replay was performed in this curation. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.
